Most of my gaming experience has involved battle mats, terrain or grids. In fact i have boxes of paper terrain stuck all over my apartment.

Recently I started GMing a pathfinder campaign for my bother and some friends via WhatsAp, this lead to a much more theatre of the mind style of play and I feel like in some ways it has allowed some of the players to be much more creative then they would have been with a map in front of them, but the group is only three players.

Since then while running Call of Cthuhlu with another group I didn't use a single map or mini. It was liberating but I also found that combat was much harder to run, because not everyone could remember where everyone was. So here is my question, how do you run combat effectively for larger groups while not using maps and minis?
